dominant_color_description: Deep reddish-brown background with slightly lighter amber-brown geometric circle overlays.
legibility_reason: High contrast between the white sans-serif text and the dark brown background makes it extremely easy to read.
layout_notes: Centered typography with subtle geometric circle elements in the top-left and bottom-right corners.

per_criterion.evidence: The palette relies heavily on dark brown and deep reddish-brown tones rather than bright, vibrant warm summer colors like coral, amber, and yellow.

reasoning: The banner features clear, legible white text on an earthy brown background. While it has clean typography, its color scheme leans heavily toward deep brown/rust rather than a bright, vibrant warm summer palette.
